Helpy / Ways neighbors help

Give it away to someone down the street

The wardrobe that didn't fit in the new place. A stroller you're done with. A shelf of books nobody reads. Rather than bin them, post them on Helpy and the people closest to you see them first. Looking for something? You can ask, too.

Download on theApp StoreGet it onGoogle Play

For example

  • Furniture: wardrobes, tables, chairs
  • Baby and kids' gear
  • Books, games and kitchenware
  • Small appliances that still work

How it works

  1. Download HelpyIt's free on iPhone and Android. Sign in with Google, or with Apple on iPhone.
  2. Post or browseSay what you need, or scroll to see who nearby is offering help.
  3. Sort it out in chatAgree on where and when, meet up, then rate each other.

Good to know

  • Add a photo, and be honest about size and condition.
  • Arrange pickup at the building entrance or somewhere public.
  • Giveaways are free. If someone asks for money, you can report them in the app.

Questions

Who gets the item?

You decide. See who reached out, chat with them, and pick who it goes to.

Can I sell things on Helpy?

No. Helpy is for help and free giveaways. For selling, use somewhere else.

Does it cost anything?

No. The app is free, and help between neighbors is never paid.

Who can see where I live?

Posts show a rough area and a distance, never an address. Your exact location is only shared with the neighbor you approve.

Is it safe?

Before you reach out to a neighbor, you verify your phone number. Profiles carry ratings and reviews, and you can report or block anyone in one tap. We don't run background checks, so whether to meet is always your call.
